notes.title: New Destructible Survival Map
notes.notes:
A new map has been added to survival, featuring destructible buildings. This also changes the smoke grenade into an airstrike, so be wary of your smoke grenades signaling an explosion on your position. This will be changed in a future update to only happen in survival.

Other changes:
-One new playable character per team.
-Updated hitboxes to be more accurate.
-Cars are now easier to turn/drive. This may be updated further later to make easier to drive.

Changes coming in another update:
-The new survival map will later be updated with a mini-map and the melee section of the loadouts will no longer be in the game, as I do not plan to add any melee weapons.

notes.title: Planetary Conflict No Longer Shutting Down
notes.notes:
Thank you so much for your support, I was originally going to shut down the game due to costs of running the servers, but after I announced this a lot of you purchased the game, which I did not see coming. As a result of this and the feedback from users I have decided I will keep the game up.

You guys are truly amazing and thank you.

notes.title: Planetary Conflict: 2301 Shutting Down Soon
notes.notes: In order to save my money I must shut down the online service for Planetary Conflict: 2301 and remove it from sale. I can't afford to pay the fee to keep the servers up. Thank you to all of you who have played and supported the game.

notes.title: Small Update
notes.notes:
-Driving animations in car fixed.

-Fixes to Desert Town map spawns.

notes.title: Solaris Strike Renamed to Planetary Conflict: 2301
notes.notes:
IMPORTANT: The game is called "Solaris Strike" in your Steam library, it will be called this until Steam approves my request to change the name to "Planetary Conflict: 2301".
"Solaris Strike" was the old name for the game until I decided to change it.

I hope you have fun playing this game! It certainly isn't finished, and updates will be added to add new content and fix existing bugs.
